title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nginx security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities have been identified in the nginx web and proxy server's ngx_http_core_module. One is a heap-based buffer overflow triggered via alias with rewrite referencing $request_filename (CVE-2026-15176), and the other is an unspecified vulnerability (CVE-2026-97205). Red Hat has issued an important security advisory with updates for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 to address these issues.
